description: This is a React component for the NutritionPage of a health and fitness tracker application. It manages meal logs, allowing users to add, edit, or delete meals, and displays a list of meals sorted by dateTime. It utilizes React hooks and context for state and data management.

methods.name: beginAdd
methods.description: Initiates the process to add a new meal by resetting editing state and setting adding to true.

methods.name: cancelAdd
methods.description: Cancels the adding process by setting adding to false.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Starts editing a specific meal by setting the editing state with the selected meal.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing process by resetting the editing state to null.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new meal, manages saving state, and calls external addMeal function.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Handles updating a meal, managing saving state, and calling external updateMeal function.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a meal after user confirmation by calling external deleteMeal function.
